synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO computes POE10 and POE90 by applying scaling factors to the POE50 forecast.

document_statements.quote: The 10% and 90% POE forecasts are derived from the 50% POE forecast.
The Demand Forecasting System or DFS generates the 10%, 50% and 90% POE demand forecasts to be used in pre-dispatch and STPASA processes.
Process MTPASA uses 10% and 50% POE operational demand forecasts for modelling.

citations.supports: Says MTPASA uses POE10 and POE50 forecasts and reports native POE forecasts for MTPASA.

uncertainties: The retrieved MTPASA wording ('10% and 50% POE native demand forecasts are also reported') [c3] could mean MTPASA records POE values produced specifically for that process rather than scaled values; the retrieved passages do not resolve whether any processes (e.g. MTPASA) run independent POE10/90 models.
The exact scaling-factor tables, how they vary by half-hour, and the technical details of how DFS implements the scaling are not present in the retrieved passages [c1,c2].
missing_evidence: MTPASA Process Description referenced by aemo_demand_terms#p24c54 (to determine whether MTPASA produces independent 'native' POE10/90 forecasts).
Demand Forecasting System (DFS) technical or configuration documentation showing the scaling-factor values and method (to confirm how POE10 and POE90 are computed from POE50 in practice).
